∃ (board : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℕ) (queens : Finset (Fin 5 × Fin 5)),
  
  (∀ i j, 1 ≤ board i j ∧ board i j ≤ 5) ∧
  
  (∀ i, Finset.univ.image (board i ·) = Finset.range 5) ∧
  
  (∀ j, Finset.univ.image (λ i => board i j) = Finset.range 5) ∧
  
  (∀ q1 q2, q1 ∈ queens → q2 ∈ queens → q1 ≠ q2 → 
    q1.1 ≠ q2.1 ∧ q1.2 ≠ q2.2 ∧ q1.1 + q2.1 ≠ 4 ∧ q1.2 + q2.2 ≠ 4) ∧
  
  board 0 1 < board 0 2 ∧
  board 1 3 = 4 ∧
  board 1 4 = 2 ∧
  board 2 2 = 5 ∧
  board 2 4 = 1 ∧
  board 3 1 = 4 ∧
  board 3 4 = 1 ∧
  board 4 0 = 3 ∧
  board 4 3 = 5

∃ (grid : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℕ),
  
  (∀ i j, grid i j = 0 ∨ grid i j = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i, ∀ k ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 4, 5} : Finset ℕ), 
    ∃! j, grid i j = k) ∧
  
  (∀ j, ∀ k ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 4, 5} : Finset ℕ), 
    ∃! i, grid i j = k) ∧
  
  grid 0 2 = 1 ∧ grid 0 4 = 4 ∧
  grid 1 3 = 3 ∧ grid 1 4 = 5 ∧
  grid 2 0 = 5 ∧ grid 2 3 = 1 ∧
  grid 3 1 = 4 ∧ grid 3 4 = 1 ∧
  grid 4 1 = 5 ∧
  
  grid 1 3 = 3 ∧ grid 1 4 = 5 ∧ 3 < 5 ∧
  grid 3 1 = 4 ∧ grid 3 4 = 1 ∧ 4 > 1 ∧
  grid 4 1 = 5 ∧
  
  (∀ i : Fin 5, 
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => grid i j = 1)).sum (fun j => (j.val + 1)) = 
    match i with
    | 0 => 11
    | 1 => 10  
    | 2 => 13
    | 3 => 9
    | 4 => 12) ∧
  
  (∀ j : Fin 5, 
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => grid i j = 1)).sum (fun i => (i.val + 1)) = 
    match j with
    | 0 => 12
    | 1 => 10
    | 2 => 9
    | 3 => 13
    | 4 => 11)

∃ (A : Fin 5 → Fin 4 → ℕ), 
  (∀ i j, A i j = 0 ∨ A i j = 1) ∧ 
  (∀ i, (Finset.sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) (fun j => A i j * (j.val + 1))) = 
        if i.val = 0 then 5 
        else if i.val = 1 then 4 
        else if i.val = 2 then 3 
        else if i.val = 3 then 2 
        else 2) ∧
  (∀ j, (Finset.sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5)) (fun i => A i j * (i.val + 1))) = 
        if j.val = 0 then 1 
        else if j.val = 1 then 9 
        else if j.val = 2 then 3 
        else 3)

∃ (board : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Bool) (true_count false_count : ℕ),
    
    
    (board 1 5 = true) ∧ (board 4 3 = true) ∧ (board 7 1 = true) ∧
    
    (∃ (pos1 pos2 : Fin 8 × Fin 8), 
      board pos1.1 pos1.2 = true ∧ 
      board pos2.1 pos2.2 = true ∧
      
      pos1 ≠ pos2 ∧
      pos1.1 ≠ pos2.1 ∧ 
      pos1.2 ≠ pos2.2 ∧
      pos1.1 + pos1.2 ≠ pos2.1 + pos2.2 ∧
      pos1.1 - pos1.2 ≠ pos2.1 - pos2.2) ∧
    
    (∃ (statement_positions : Fin 7 → Fin 8 × Fin 8),
      
      
      (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = true) Finset.univ) ≥ 3) ∧
      
      (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = false) Finset.univ) ≤ 7) ∧
      
      (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = true) Finset.univ) = 4) ∧
      
      (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = false) Finset.univ) = 3) ∧
      
      ((Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = true) Finset.univ) = 4) ≠ 
       (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = false) Finset.univ) = 3)) ∧
      
      (Nat.Prime (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = true) Finset.univ))) ∧
      
      (¬Nat.Prime (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = false) Finset.univ)) ∧ 
       Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = false) Finset.univ) > 1) ∧
      
      (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => board (statement_positions i).1 (statement_positions i).2 = false) Finset.univ) = 3)) ∧
    
    (Nat.Prime true_count) ∧
    
    (¬Nat.Prime false_count ∧ false_count > 1) ∧
    
    (true_count + false_count = 7)

∃ (coloring : Fin 10 → Fin 3),
  
  (∀ i j : Fin 10, (i, j) ∈ [(1, 6), (2, 3), (6, 7), (6, 9)] → coloring i ≠ coloring j) ∧
  
  (∃ (statement_values : Fin 7 → Bool),
    
    (Nat.Prime (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => statement_values i) Finset.univ))) ∧
    
    (¬Nat.Prime (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => ¬statement_values i) Finset.univ))) ∧
    
    (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => statement_values i) Finset.univ) ≥ 2) ∧
    
    (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => ¬statement_values i) Finset.univ) ≤ 3) ∧
    
    (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => statement_values i) Finset.univ) = 4) ∧
    
    (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => ¬statement_values i) Finset.univ) = 3) ∧
    
    ((statement_values 2 ∧ ¬statement_values 3) ∨ (¬statement_values 2 ∧ statement_values 3)) ∧
    
    (Nat.Prime (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => statement_values i) Finset.univ))) ∧
    
    (¬Nat.Prime (Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun i => ¬statement_values i) Finset.univ)))
  )

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4) 
    (row_weighted_sums : Fin 4 → ℕ)
    (col_weighted_sums : Fin 4 → ℕ),
  
  (∀ i j, grid i j ∈ Finset.univ) ∧
  
  
  (∀ i : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.image (grid i ·)) = Finset.univ) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.image (fun i => grid i j)) = Finset.univ) ∧
  (∀ i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin 4, 
    i₁.val < 2 ∧ j₁.val < 2 ∧ i₂.val < 2 ∧ j₂.val < 2 ∧
    i₁ ≠ i₂ ∨ j₁ ≠ j₂ → 
    grid i₁ j₁ ≠ grid i₂ j₂) ∧
  
  
  (∀ i j : Fin 4, grid i j = 1 → 
    row_weighted_sums i + (j.val + 1) = (j.val + 1) + col_weighted_sums j) ∧
  (∀ i j : Fin 4, grid i j = 0 → 
    row_weighted_sums i = row_weighted_sums i ∧ 
    col_weighted_sums j = col_weighted_sums j)

∃ (futoshiki_solution : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4),
    
    (∀ i : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.image (futoshiki_solution i)) = {0, 1, 2, 3}) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.image (fun i => futoshiki_solution i j)) = {0, 1, 2, 3}) ∧
    
    (futoshiki_solution 0 0 < futoshiki_solution 0 1 ∧ 
     futoshiki_solution 0 1 > futoshiki_solution 0 2 ∧
     futoshiki_solution 0 2 > futoshiki_solution 0 3) ∧
    (futoshiki_solution 1 0 < futoshiki_solution 1 1 ∧ 
     futoshiki_solution 1 1 < futoshiki_solution 1 2 ∧
     futoshiki_solution 1 2 < futoshiki_solution 1 3) ∧
    (futoshiki_solution 2 0 < futoshiki_solution 2 1 ∧ 
     futoshiki_solution 2 1 > futoshiki_solution 2 2 ∧
     futoshiki_solution 2 2 > futoshiki_solution 2 3) ∧
    (futoshiki_solution 3 0 < futoshiki_solution 3 1 ∧ 
     futoshiki_solution 3 1 > futoshiki_solution 3 2) ∧
    
    ((futoshiki_solution 0 0 > futoshiki_solution 1 0 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 0 < futoshiki_solution 2 0) ∨
     (futoshiki_solution 0 0 < futoshiki_solution 1 0 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 0 > futoshiki_solution 2 0)) ∧
    ((futoshiki_solution 0 1 > futoshiki_solution 1 1 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 1 < futoshiki_solution 2 1) ∨
     (futoshiki_solution 0 1 < futoshiki_solution 1 1 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 1 > futoshiki_solution 2 1)) ∧
    ((futoshiki_solution 0 2 > futoshiki_solution 1 2 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 2 < futoshiki_solution 2 2) ∨
     (futoshiki_solution 0 2 < futoshiki_solution 1 2 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 2 > futoshiki_solution 2 2)) ∧
    ((futoshiki_solution 0 3 > futoshiki_solution 1 3 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 3 < futoshiki_solution 2 3) ∨
     (futoshiki_solution 0 3 < futoshiki_solution 1 3 ∧ 
      futoshiki_solution 1 3 > futoshiki_solution 2 3)) ∧
    
    ∃ (T : ℕ) (statement_values : Fin 7 → Bool),
      T + (7 - T) = 7 ∧
      
      let statement_1 := statement_values 0
      let statement_2 := statement_values 1
      let statement_3 := statement_values 2
      let statement_4 := statement_values 3
      let statement_5 := statement_values 4
      let statement_6 := statement_values 5
      let statement_7 := statement_values 6
      
      (statement_1 ↔ T ≥ 2) ∧
      (statement_2 ↔ T ≤ 4) ∧
      (statement_3 ↔ T = 5) ∧
      (statement_4 ↔ T = 0) ∧
      (statement_5 ↔ (statement_3 ≠ statement_4)) ∧
      (statement_6 ↔ Nat.Prime T) ∧
      (statement_7 ↔ ¬Nat.Prime (7 - T) ∧ 7 - T > 1) ∧
      
      (∃ (solutions : Finset (Fin 7 → Bool)),
        solutions.card = 2 ∧
        ∀ (val : Fin 7 → Bool), val ∈ solutions ↔ 
          (let t := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => val i)).card
           t = T ∧
           (val 0 ↔ t ≥ 2) ∧
           (val 1 ↔ t ≤ 4) ∧
           (val 2 ↔ t = 5) ∧
           (val 3 ↔ t = 0) ∧
           (val 4 ↔ (val 2 ≠ val 3)) ∧
           (val 5 ↔ Nat.Prime t) ∧
           (val 6 ↔ ¬Nat.Prime (7 - t) ∧ 7 - t > 1)))

∃ (board : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Char),
    
    (∀ i j, board i j = '0') ∧
    
    (∃ ( queen_positions : Finset (Fin 8 × Fin 8)), 
      queen_positions.card = 8 ∧
      ∀ (i j : Fin 8), (i, j) ∈ queen_positions → board i j = 'Q') ∧
    
    (∀ (i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin 8), 
      (i₁, j₁) ≠ (i₂, j₂) →
      board i₁ j₁ = 'Q' → board i₂ j₂ = 'Q' →
      ¬(i₁ = i₂ ∨ j₁ = j₂ ∨ i₁ + j₁ = i₂ + j₂ ∨ i₁ + j₁ = 7 - i₂ - j₂)) ∧
    
    (∀ i : Fin 8, 
      (Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j => board i j = '1' ∨ board i j = 'Q') Finset.univ) 
        (fun j => (j.val + 1) * (i.val + 1))) = [12, 14, 15, 13, 10, 11, 16, 17][i.val]!) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 8, 
      (Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun i => board i j = '1' ∨ board i j = 'Q') Finset.univ) 
        (fun i => (i.val + 1) * (j.val + 1))) = [13, 12, 11, 10, 14, 15, 16, 17][j.val]!)

∃ (coloring : Fin 10 → Fin 3),
    
    (∀ i j : Fin 10, (i.val + 1, j.val + 1) ∈ [(1, 4), (1, 9), (2, 3), (2, 6)] → 
      coloring i ≠ coloring j) ∧
    
    (∀ r : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.filter (fun c => coloring c = 1)).sum (fun c => (c.val + 1 : ℕ)) = 
      if r.val = 0 then 1
      else if r.val = 1 then 5  
      else if r.val = 2 then 6
      else 4) ∧
    
    (∀ c : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r => coloring r = 1)).sum (fun r => (r.val + 1 : ℕ)) = 
      if c.val = 0 then 4
      else if c.val = 1 then 3
      else if c.val = 2 then 3
      else if c.val = 3 then 4
      else 2) ∧
    
    coloring = ![2, 0, 2, 0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 0, 2]

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4),
    
    (∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ n : Fin 4, ∃! j : Fin 4, grid i j = n) ∧
    
    (∀ j : Fin 4, ∀ n : Fin 4, ∃! i : Fin 4, grid i j = n) ∧
    
    (∀ i j : Fin 2, ∀ n : Fin 4, ∃! k : Fin 4, 
      grid (i + k) (j + k) = n) ∧
    
    ∃ (coloring : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 3),
      
      (∀ i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin 4,
        
        (i₁ = i₂ ∧ j₁ ≠ j₂) ∨
        
        (j₁ = j₂ ∧ i₁ ≠ i₂) ∨
        
        (∃ a b : Fin 2, i₁ = a + i₂ ∧ j₁ = b + j₂) →
        coloring i₁ j₁ ≠ coloring i₂ j₂)

∃ (altruists : Finset (Fin 7)) (true_count : ℕ),
  
  true_count = (altruists.filter (fun i => i.val < 7)).card ∧
  
  (∀ i : Fin 7, i ∈ altruists ∨ i ∉ altruists) ∧
  
  
  (true_count ≥ 4) ∧
  
  (7 - true_count ≤ 4) ∧
  
  (true_count = 4) ∧
  
  (7 - true_count = 3) ∧
  
  ((true_count = 4 ∧ 7 - true_count = 3) ∨ (true_count ≠ 4 ∧ 7 - true_count ≠ 3)) ∧
  
  Nat.Prime true_count ∧
  
  (7 - true_count > 1 ∧ ¬Nat.Prime (7 - true_count)) ∧
  
  (let roles := fun i : Fin 7 => if i ∈ altruists then "altruist" else "egoist"
   roles 0 = roles 1 ∧ roles 1 = roles 2 ∧ roles 2 = roles 3 ∧ 
   roles 3 = roles 4 ∧ roles 4 = roles 5 ∧ roles 5 = roles 6)

∃ (grid : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Bool),
  
  (∃ (queen_positions : Finset (Fin 8 × Fin 8)), 
    queen_positions.card = 8 ∧
    (∀ (i j : Fin 8), grid i j = true ↔ (i, j) ∈ queen_positions) ∧
    
    (∀ (i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin 8), 
      grid i₁ j₁ = true → grid i₂ j₂ = true → 
      (i₁, j₁) ≠ (i₂, j₂) → 
      i₁ ≠ i₂ → j₁ ≠ j₂ → i₁ + j₁ ≠ i₂ + j₂) ∧
    
    (∀ i : Fin 8, (Finset.univ.filter (λ j => grid i j = true)).sum (λ j => j.val + 1) = 
      if i = 0 then 10
      else if i = 1 then 4
      else if i = 2 then 5
      else if i = 3 then 1
      else if i = 4 then 11
      else if i = 5 then 8
      else if i = 6 then 6
      else 5) ∧
    
    (∀ j : Fin 8, (Finset.univ.filter (λ i => grid i j = true)).sum (λ i => i.val + 1) = 
      if j = 0 then 5
      else if j = 1 then 9
      else if j = 2 then 4
      else if j = 3 then 8
      else if j = 4 then 5
      else if j = 5 then 10
      else if j = 6 then 6
      else 7))

∃ (grid : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 2),
    
    (∀ i : Fin 5, 
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => grid i j = 1)).sum (fun j => (j.val + 1 : ℕ)) = 
      match i with 
      | 0 => 2
      | 1 => 4  
      | 2 => 5
      | 3 => 1
      | 4 => 3) ∧
    
    (∀ j : Fin 5,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => grid i j = 1)).sum (fun i => (i.val + 1 : ℕ)) = 
      match j with
      | 0 => 4
      | 1 => 1
      | 2 => 5
      | 3 => 2  
      | 4 => 3) ∧
    
    (∀ i j : Fin 5, grid i j = 0 ∨ grid i j = 1) ∧
    
    (∀ i j : Fin 5, grid i j = 0 → ¬(∃ k : Fin 5, grid k k = 1 ∧ k = i ∧ k = j)) ∧
    
    (∀ i j : Fin 5, grid i j = 1 → ∃ k : Fin 5, grid k k = 1 ∧ k = i ∧ k = j) ∧
    
    (∃ i j : Fin 5, grid i j = 1 ∧ ∃ k l : Fin 5, grid k l = 0 ∧ (i, j) ≠ (k, l))

∃! (board : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℕ),
    
    (board 0 3 = 4) ∧
    (board 1 0 = 2) ∧
    (board 1 3 = 3) ∧
    (board 2 2 = 3) ∧
    (board 3 0 = 3) ∧
    (board 3 2 = 2) ∧
    
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board 0 q = 1) ∧
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board 1 q = 1) ∧
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board 2 q = 1) ∧
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board 3 q = 1) ∧
    
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board q 0 = 1) ∧
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board q 1 = 1) ∧
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board q 2 = 1) ∧
    (∃! q : Fin 4, board q 3 = 1) ∧
    
    (∀ i j k l : Fin 4, 
      board i j = 1 → board k l = 1 → 
      (i = k ∧ j = l) ∨ (i ≠ k ∧ j ≠ l ∧ i + j = k + l) → 
      False) ∧
    
    (∀ i j : Fin 2, 
      (Finset.filter (fun p => board (i + p.1) (j + p.2) = 1) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Fin 2))).card = 1) ∧
    
    (Finset.filter (fun p => board p.1 p.2 = 1) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × Fin 4))).card = 4

∃ (coloring : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4),
    
    (∀ i j, coloring i j < 4) ∧
    
    (∀ i j i' j', (i = i' ∧ (j.val + 1 = j'.val ∨ j.val = j'.val + 1)) ∨ 
                  (j = j' ∧ (i.val + 1 = i'.val ∨ i.val = i'.val + 1)) → 
                  coloring i j ≠ coloring i' j') ∧
    
    (∀ i j, ∃ (sudoku_value : Fin 4), 
      
      (∀ k l, k ≠ i ∨ l ≠ j → coloring k l ≠ sudoku_value) ∧
      coloring i j = sudoku_value)

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Bool) (truth_assignment : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Bool),
    
    
    (∀ i j, grid i j = truth_assignment i j ∨ grid i j = ¬truth_assignment i j) ∧
    
    (∃ (row_weights : Fin 4 → ℚ) (col_weights : Fin 5 → ℚ),
      
      (∀ i, (Finset.univ.sum fun j => row_weights i * (if grid i j then 1 else 0)) = 
            (Finset.univ.sum fun j => row_weights i * (if truth_assignment i j then 1 else 0))) ∧
      
      (∀ j, (Finset.univ.sum fun i => col_weights j * (if grid i j then 1 else 0)) = 
            (Finset.univ.sum fun i => col_weights j * (if truth_assignment i j then 1 else 0))) ∧
      
      (Finset.univ.sum fun i => row_weights i) = (Finset.univ.sum fun j => col_weights j)) ∧
    
    (∀ i j, (grid i j = true → truth_assignment i j = true) ∧ 
            (grid i j = false → truth_assignment i j = false))

∃ (coloring : Fin 64 → Fin 3),
  ∀ i j : Fin 64, 
    let pos1 := (i.val / 8, i.val % 8)
    let pos2 := (j.val / 8, j.val % 8)
    let same_row := pos1.1 = pos2.1
    let same_col := pos1.2 = pos2.2  
    let same_diag := pos1.1 + pos1.2 = pos2.1 + pos2.2 ∨ 
                     pos1.1 - pos1.2 = pos2.1 - pos2.2
    same_row ∨ same_col ∨ same_diag → 
    coloring i ≠ coloring j

∃ (coloring : Fin 7 → ℕ), 
  
  (∀ i, coloring i ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Set ℕ)) ∧
  
  (∀ i j, (i, j) ∈ [(0, 1), (1, 2), (3, 4), (5, 6)] → coloring i ≠ coloring j) ∧
  
  let num_true := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => coloring i = 1)).card
  let num_false := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => coloring i = 2)).card
  
  (num_true ≥ 4) ∧
  
  (num_false ≤ 5) ∧
  
  (num_true = 4) ∧
  
  (num_false = 3) ∧
  
  
  (num_false = 3 ∨ num_true = 4) ∧
  
  (Nat.Prime num_true) ∧
  
  (num_false > 1 ∧ ¬Nat.Prime num_false)

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Char),
  
  (∀ i j, grid i j ∈ ({'0', '1', 'Q'} : Set Char)) ∧
  
  (∑ j, if grid 0 j = '1' then 1 else if grid 0 j = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 4 ∧
  (∑ j, if grid 1 j = '1' then 1 else if grid 1 j = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 3 ∧
  (∑ j, if grid 2 j = '1' then 1 else if grid 2 j = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 7 ∧
  (∑ j, if grid 3 j = '1' then 1 else if grid 3 j = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 3 ∧
  
  (∑ i, if grid i 0 = '1' then 1 else if grid i 0 = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 4 ∧
  (∑ i, if grid i 1 = '1' then 1 else if grid i 1 = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 4 ∧
  (∑ i, if grid i 2 = '1' then 1 else if grid i 2 = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 5 ∧
  (∑ i, if grid i 3 = '1' then 1 else if grid i 3 = 'Q' then 0 else 0) = 4 ∧
  
  (∀ i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂, grid i₁ j₁ = 'Q' → grid i₂ j₂ = 'Q' → 
    ¬(i₁ = i₂ ∧ j₁ = j₂) ∧ ¬(i₁ = i₂ ∧ j₁ ≠ j₂) ∧ ¬(i₁ ≠ i₂ ∧ j₁ = j₂) ∧ 
    ¬(i₁ + j₁ = i₂ + j₂) ∧ ¬(i₁ - j₁ = i₂ - j₂))

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 2) (coloring : Fin 20 → Fin 3),
  
  (∀ i : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.sum fun j => (j.val + 1) * grid i j) = 
    if i = 0 then 2 else if i = 1 then 8 else 4) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.sum fun i => (i.val + 1) * grid i j) = 
    if j = 0 then 6 else if j = 1 then 3 else if j = 2 then 4 else if j = 3 then 3 else 2) ∧
  
  (∀ v₁ v₂ : Fin 20, 
    let pos₁ := v₁.val
    let pos₂ := v₂.val
    
    ((pos₁ = 0 ∧ pos₂ = 4) ∨ (pos₁ = 4 ∧ pos₂ = 0) ∨
     (pos₁ = 1 ∧ pos₂ = 2) ∨ (pos₁ = 2 ∧ pos₂ = 1) ∨
     (pos₁ = 2 ∧ pos₂ = 4) ∨ (pos₁ = 4 ∧ pos₂ = 2)) →
    coloring v₁ ≠ coloring v₂) ∧
